page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan: the left page shows a narrow strip of text at the far left edge (partly cut), the right page carries the main text block with marginal notes on its left side and a running head at the top. Right page: running head line, then main text in one column with notes in the left margin.; One block of text in the centre-right with marginal notes in the right margin (set beside the lines), and a few partial marginal fragments at the far left edge outside the text block; the text continues to the lower part of the page.

main_text.p: In CRETA fuit adhuc Minos, cujus uxor Pasiphae, quia occasiones adulterii ex labyrintho fumpsit, ideò Dædalus in carcerem conjectus est, ex quo elapsus, in Siciliam ad Cocalum pervenit.Diodor. Sic. lib. 4.
In PHRYGIA Priamus jussit Argonautas, de quibus mox, finibus suis excedere. Illi vim fecere, & Hesione soror ejus pellex Telamonis facta est.Medsalacor. in pro-gen. Angust.

Apud LYDOS coepisse Heraclidarum hoc tempore familia dicitur. Stirps ipsorum Laomedon seu Alcaeus, Herculis ex Omphale, Atyada Sardis regnantium familiæ, filius. Ab eo ad Ardysum, qui in tempora Ulsiæ Azariæ incidit, octodecim Reges numerantur, ex quibus Argos seu Meles Sardes Regnum transtulit, & Leo F. dentium os continuum habuit. Reliqui ignorantur. Caeterum inter Attyadas fuit & Cambletes, qui uxorem suam dilaniavit & comedit; re vulgatâ, se ipsum jugulavit; & Adramytes, qui primus omnium mulieres fecit Eunuchas, eisque vice Eunuchorum usus est.Athen. l. 12. {*}ÆGYPTO præfuit * Ammenemes, cui fuc- AFRICA-NA cessit † Thuoris.
{†}In SVECIA forte adhuc vixit Gothlias, & EVROPÆA exortas inter suos nepotes de regno Daniæ con- Magn. l. s. Hist. Sueon. troversias, amoto Lothero, sedavit.
{*}In GERMANIA vixit* Brennus, Ulfin- gi F.
{†}In ITALIA successit Evandro † Latinus, Berosi l. s Herculis ex Lavinia F.

page.notes: The left page is cut off and only fragments of its text remain at the left edge, so it is not transcribed. Marginal notes are partly illegible in the scan. Marginal fragments at the far left edge (partial words such as "ejus", "vit", "la") are cut and only partly legible, so they are omitted. Numbers in the left margin are partly cut off and uncertain. The continuation of the line "Phe-" with "F" beneath is a lower fragment of the scan.
